{{Youmay|Murrey, a character from [[Harvest Moon DS]]|[[Murrey (AWL)|Murrey]], a character from [[Harvest Moon: A Wonderful Life|A Wonderful Life]] or [[Pui (SoSAWL)|Pui]], a character from [[Story of Seasons: A Wonderful Life]]}}
{{Nihongo|Murry|モイ|Moi}} is the local homeless man in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]].''

Not much is known about Murrey's past, as he has no family. He has no home, but sleeps under the Harvest Sprite's large tree near the Goddess Pond.

Unlike in ''[[Harvest Moon: A Wonderful Life|A Wonderful Life]]'', Murrey does not steal food from your farm, nor does he beg for donations. He also doesn't mention Popo Valley. However, when you faint, he helps you back to your house but will steal half of your money. He's always hungry and seems a bit sad, but he is harmless.

Murrey will spend time at the Villa, Blue Bar or the Inn, hoping that somebody will be generous enough to give him something to eat. Otherwise, he can be found at the Goddess Pond.

He has two pet flies that always buzz around his head that never leave him.
